services.title: Birth Certificate (Local Copy)
services.description: Request a local copy of a birth record through the City Civil Registrar. Local copies, birth registration and PSA copies have different application routes.
services.office: Office of the City Civil Registrar

services.title: Marriage Registration, Local Copy and Marriage License
services.description: Choose the transaction you need: marriage registration, a local certified copy, or a marriage-license application. Each has its own checklist and processing period.
services.office: Office of the City Civil Registrar

services.title: Death Registration and Local Copy
services.description: Civil registration and local copies are handled by the City Civil Registrar. Health certification, transfer of remains and burial permits are separate transactions with other offices.
services.office: Office of the City Civil Registrar / Office of the City Health Officer / Transportation Development and Regulatory Office

services.title: Barangay Clearance
services.description: Contact your own barangay for a general barangay clearance. For city business registration, barangay clearance is integrated into the permitting process described in the Charter.

services.title: Barangay ID
services.description: Ask your barangay whether it issues resident IDs and where to apply. The Charter’s barangay/SK official-ID service does not establish a general resident-ID program.

services.title: Police Clearance — PNP Referral
services.description: Contact the Philippine National Police for its current clearance application channel and processing location. This City Charter does not establish a city-government police-clearance service.

services.title: New Business Registration (On-Site)
services.description: Apply through BPLO for on-site new business registration. The Charter describes an appointment Transaction Slip and OSCP compliance or tagging conditions.

services.title: Business Registration Renewal (On-Site)
services.description: Apply through BPLO for on-site business registration renewal. Consult the renewal checklist rather than the new-business checklist.

services.title: Business Closure Certificate
services.description: Request a Closure Certificate from the City Treasurer’s Administrative Division. Closure requirements of BIR, SSS and other agencies are separate.

services.title: Sanitary Permit (New and Renewal)
services.description: Apply for a new or renewed sanitary permit through the City Health Officer’s Environmental Sanitation Division. This is separate from a worker’s health certificate.
services.office: Office of the City Health Officer

services.title: Community Tax Certificate (Individual or Corporation)
services.description: Request an individual or corporate Community Tax Certificate from the City Treasurer. Requirements and assessment depend on the applicant type.

services.title: Senior Citizens Identification Card
services.description: Apply through OSCA. New issuance, replacement of a lost card, correction/change of address, and cancellation have separate procedures.

services.title: Persons with Disability ID
services.description: Apply through CSWDO for a Persons with Disability ID. Assistive devices and other benefits have separate eligibility and application requirements.
services.office: Office of the City Social Welfare and Development Officer

services.title: Crisis Assistance — Assessment Required
services.description: CSWDO and the Mayor’s Action Center have different crisis-assistance programs. Ask which medical, funeral or special-case service applies; assistance is subject to assessment.
services.office: Office of the City Social Welfare and Development Officer / Mayor’s Action Center

services.title: Funeral Assistance
services.description: Funeral assistance is documented under CSWDO AICS and the Mayor’s Action Center. Check the appropriate program’s eligibility and checklist before applying.
services.office: Office of the City Social Welfare and Development Officer / Mayor’s Action Center

services.title: Solo Parent ID
services.description: Apply through CSWDO’s Family Welfare Program. The required supporting documents depend on the applicant’s qualifying circumstances.
services.office: Office of the City Social Welfare and Development Officer

services.title: Immunization Services
services.description: Contact the City Health Officer’s Nursing Division for routine immunization, school-based vaccination or anti-rabies services. Confirm the assigned clinic and schedule before visiting.
services.office: Office of the City Health Officer

services.title: Health Certificate for Food and Non-Food Handlers
services.description: Food and non-food handlers apply through the Environmental Sanitation Division. A health certificate for workers is different from a medical certificate after consultation.
services.office: Office of the City Health Officer

services.title: Medical Assistance and Healthcard Referrals
services.description: Check the appropriate CSWDO, Mayor’s Action Center or City Healthcard program for hospital, medicine or treatment support. These are separate from ordinary medical consultations.
services.office: Office of the City Social Welfare and Development Officer / Mayor’s Action Center / Office of the City Health Officer

services.title: Pre-Natal Check Up
services.description: The Nursing Division provides prenatal assessment and care. Bring the Mother and Child Book listed in the Charter and confirm the assigned clinic and schedule.
services.office: Office of the City Health Officer

services.title: Real Property Tax Assessment and Collection
services.description: The City Treasurer’s Real Property Tax Division handles assessment and collection. Payment due depends on the property assessment and applicable charges.

services.title: Business Registration Tax and Fee Assessment
services.description: Business taxes and fees are assessed as part of the relevant BPLO registration or renewal transaction. Check the applicable transaction and assessed amount before paying.
services.office: Business Permits and Licensing Office / Office of the City Treasurer

services.title: Real Property Tax Clearance / Cancellation of Warrant of Levy
services.description: Request real-property tax clearance or cancellation of a warrant of levy from the City Treasurer. This is different from a national BIR tax clearance.

services.title: Agricultural Loans — Program Confirmation Needed
services.description: This Charter does not confirm a general agricultural-loan product. Ask the City Agriculturist about specific programs; cooperative assistance and livestock dispersal have different eligibility.
services.office: Office of the City Agriculturist / Office of the City Veterinarian

services.title: PCIC Livestock Insurance Assistance
services.description: The documented city assistance route covers RSBSA-registered livestock raisers applying to PCIC. Crop coverage needs separate confirmation and must not be assumed from the livestock program.

services.title: Request for Farm Inputs
services.description: Request farm inputs through the City Agriculturist’s Crops Production Division. Availability, assessment and the requested inputs determine the applicable assistance.

services.title: Building Permit — OSCP
services.description: Apply through OSCP using the correct simple, complex or highly technical transaction. The checklist and processing period depend on the application classification.

services.title: Certificate of Use / Occupancy
services.description: Apply through OSCP for the appropriate Certificate of Use/Occupancy transaction. Complex, highly technical and simultaneous building/occupancy routes differ.

services.title: Repair and Maintenance of Public Infrastructure
services.description: Request repair or maintenance of public roads, bridges, schools and other public infrastructure through the City Engineer’s Maintenance Division.

services.title: City Scholarship and Financial Assistance Program
services.description: The Mayor’s Action Center administers the documented City Scholarship and Financial Assistance Program. New applications and renewals have different checklists.

services.title: Student Scholarship / Financial Assistance
services.description: The documented student-aid route is the Mayor’s Action Center scholarship and financial-assistance program. Check the applicable student category and eligibility.

services.title: Emergency Response and Patient Transport
services.description: CDRRMO handles emergency response. Scheduled patient transport, emergency clearing, water rationing and event-response deployment have separate request routes.
services.office: Office of the City Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Officer

services.title: DRRM Training, Drills and Risk Services
services.description: CDRRMO provides separate services for drills, training, risk assessment, hazard certification and plan review. Select the specific request before preparing documents.
services.office: Office of the City Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Officer

services.title: City Environmental Clearances
services.description: City ENRO issues several different city environmental documents. A City Environmental Certificate or city clearance does not replace a DENR-EMB ECC/CNC where required.
services.office: Office of the City Environment and Natural Resources Officer

services.title: Tree Pruning/Cutting Approval or DENR Endorsement
services.description: City ENRO has separate pruning, cutting-approval and DENR-endorsement routes. Confirm which applies to the tree and property before cutting.
services.office: Office of the City Environment and Natural Resources Officer

services.title: Slaughterhouse Rental and Meat Inspection
services.description: The Market Administrator handles rental-fee collection for registered lessees. Meat inspection and meat-handler licensing are separate City Veterinarian services. Confirm the operating-site address before bringing animals.
services.office: Office of the City Market Administrator / Office of the City Veterinarian

services.title: City Social Welfare and Development Services
services.description: CSWDO handles specific welfare, crisis, disability, family and livelihood services. OSCA and the Mayor’s Action Center have separate responsibilities and programs.
services.office: Office of the City Social Welfare and Development Officer

services.title: Environmental Complaints, Hauling and Clean-up Requests
services.description: The Charter documents environmental complaints, hauling approvals, septic certification and GSO clean-up support. Confirm household collection arrangements separately; no citywide pickup timetable is established here.
services.office: Office of the City Environment and Natural Resources Officer / Office of the City General Services Officer

services.title: Public Market Services
services.description: The City Market Administrator handles market stall leases, rental and entrance payments, clearances and repair requests. Each transaction has its own procedure.
services.office: Office of the City Market Administrator

services.title: Business Permits and Licensing Office
services.description: BPLO handles new and renewed business registration, contractor permits, Mayor’s Clearance and other documented business certifications and permits.

services.title: Tricycle Permits and MTOP Franchise
services.description: TDRO handles motorized-tricycle inspection, Mayor’s permits and MTOP issuance, renewal, change, transfer and dropping. Confirm any Grand Terminal inspection or sticker-placement instruction before visiting.

services.title: City Treasurer Services
services.description: The City Treasurer handles documented tax, certification, cedula and payment services. Follow the specific transaction and confirm payment instructions through the official office.

services.title: City Budget Office — Appropriation/Funds Certification
services.description: The Charter’s external Budget Office service is certification of availability of funds/appropriation. This is a specific certification, not a general resident cash-assistance program.
services.office: Office of the City Budget Officer

services.title: City Accountant — Payment/Remittance Certifications
services.description: The City Accountant issues the documented remittance and gross-payment/no-transaction certifications. Employee payroll and internal voucher workflows are different processes.

services.title: Tax Declaration and Property Assessment Records
services.description: The City Assessor handles tax-declaration and assessment-record transactions for land, buildings, improvements and machinery. A tax-record update does not register or transfer a legal land title.

services.title: City Assessor Services
services.description: Choose the applicable appraisal, tax-declaration, certification, annotation or mapping service. Planning rezoning and legal land-title registration are separate processes.

services.title: City Civil Registry Services
services.description: The City Civil Registrar handles registration, local copies, corrections and other civil-registry transactions. PSA birth, marriage, death and CENOMAR requests are also documented through BREQS assistance.
services.office: Office of the City Civil Registrar

services.title: City Engineer and Construction Permits
services.description: OSCP handles construction permits. The City Engineer also provides documented public-infrastructure maintenance, technical and waterworks services with separate request procedures.

services.title: City Planning, Zoning and Development Services
services.description: Select the applicable zoning certification, sign permit, CZC, PALC/development permit, rezoning, map or data request. Requirements depend on the exact planning transaction.
services.office: Office of the City Planning and Development Coordinator

services.title: City Agriculture Services
services.description: The City Agriculturist provides documented machinery, crops, cooperative and home-extension services. RSBSA registration, fisheries and livestock-insurance assistance are listed under the City Veterinarian.
services.office: Office of the City Agriculturist / Office of the City Veterinarian

services.title: City General Services Support
services.description: GSO provides approved support requests such as tables/chairs, equipment, clean-up, carpooling, towing and facility use. Eligibility may be limited to offices, barangays, schools or other specified applicants.
services.office: Office of the City General Services Officer

services.title: City HR — Recruitment, Employee Records and OJT
services.description: City HR handles recruitment, employee-record certification and OJT requests. Employee-only leave and benefits processes must be distinguished from services open to applicants.
services.office: Office of the City Human Resource Management Officer

services.title: Online Business Registration and Renewal
services.description: The Charter documents online new registration and renewal, including assessment and payment. A separate general-purpose billing service is not established by those entries.

services.title: New Business Registration (Online)
services.description: The Charter documents online new-business registration and lists the official BPLO portal. OSCP compliance conditions apply; current portal availability has not been independently checked.

services.title: Business Registration Renewal (Online)
services.description: The Charter documents online business registration renewal. Use the official BPLO channel and its renewal checklist; current portal availability has not been independently checked.

services.title: Real Property Tax Electronic Payment
services.description: The Charter directs applicants to the official city website’s Online Real Property Payment feature. Confirm payment instructions through the official site before paying.

services.title: Online Payment Order — Confirmation Needed
services.description: A standalone general Online Payment Order service is not confirmed by the reviewed Charter chapters. Confirm the appropriate payment channel with the City Treasurer.
